query: How do I replace a worn-out cabinet bumper?

goal.title: Replace a small adhesive pad on a cabinet door
goal.description: Pick residue from the inner lower corner of an open wooden cabinet door, dampen a towel at the sink and wipe the corner, then peel a small replacement pad from its backing, press it in place and check the door.
goal.final_state: A small pad remains at the cleaned lower inside corner of the open cabinet door; hands have withdrawn.
procedure: Pick away the old material at the lower inner corner while steadying the cabinet door.
Dampen a towel at the sink and wipe the mounting area, then dry it.
Peel the backing from a small adhesive pad and position it on the corner.
Press and hold the pad firmly, release it and move the door to inspect the repair.

phases.description: The right hand steadies the open door while the left picks and rubs at the small lower inside corner fitting, then turns toward the sink with a towel.
The towel is dampened at the faucet, used repeatedly on the lower corner, then another dry portion is rubbed over the surface.
A tiny pad and backing are separated between the fingers and the pad brought toward the cleaned corner.
The small pad is positioned at the corner, then sustained finger pressure is held while the other hand supports the door until the pad is released.
The door is swung slightly and its corner inspected before both hands withdraw, leaving the cabinet open.
